intentEvidence: Daily Note Flow is an Obsidian plugin for capturing daily tasks, todos, time-based records, summaries, and weekly/monthly review notes in plain Markdown.
problem: Users need a structured way to capture daily activities, manage time-classified records, and automatically generate comprehensive summaries of their progress.
summary: A note-taking plugin that captures daily tasks and records, automatically classifies them, and generates structured weekly and monthly summary notes in Markdown.
